feeds.title: Fierce Marriage
feeds.description: We are Ryan & Selena Frederick, writers for Fierce Marriage. Our hope is that what we share encourages, challenges, and inspires you to fight fiercely for your marriage. By sharing openly, we trust that we can help each other grow and build lasting marriages.

feeds.title: Hot, Holy & Humorous Blog
feeds.description: I'm a married Christian wife who writes about sex. Biblical and blunt advice (mostly for wives) on how sex in a Christian marriage can be hot, holy & humorous!

feeds.title: XO Marriage
feeds.description: XO Marriage exists to help couples have a healthy and strong marriage. We do this by hosting conferences, creating resources, and offering encouraging digital content.

feeds.title: Marriage Helper
feeds.description: Marriage help for problems faced by married couples. We provide marriage seminars, workshops, articles, and other forms of help for relationships in danger of separation or divorce seeking reconciliation and improvement. Even in cases of affairs, resentment, and anger, we can help enrich, strengthen, and even save a marriage in danger of separation or divorce.

feeds.title: For Your Marriage
feeds.description: For Your Marriage helps couples at all stages of life to understand and live God's plan for happy, holy marriages. Whether you're engaged, married, or seriously dating, you've come to the right place for help in living a happy and holy married life.

feeds.title: Christian Family Life Blog
feeds.description: Christian Family Life founded by Don Meredith and Barry Leventhal featuring 'performance to faith' relationship principles.

feeds.title: Build Your Marriage Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Build Your Marriage! Through our blog, social media and speaking, we will bring building blocks for you and your spouse. These resources will be practical insights from life and the Bible. We are committed to strengthening healthy marriages and supporting hurting couples.

feeds.title: Changing Us Blog
feeds.description: Want to improve your marriage? Get a perspective you don't usually hear, articles that will leave you wondering what else you've missed, and an online course that will transform your relationship. You'll discover what they don't tell you in church about marriage, respect, submission, forgiveness, and love. Want to change your marriage? Find hope here through Changing Us.

feeds.title: Christian Fellowshipping Blog
feeds.description: Christian Fellowshipping encourages other Christians in their fellowship time with God and other believers by helping them understand that they can read, study, and understand the bible.

feeds.title: Amanda Davison Blog
feeds.description: Hi I am Amanda, I am a wife to a farmer and a mother of three. I am passionate about how God saved my life and saved my marriage.

feeds.title: Marriages.net
feeds.description: GTO's exclusive Christian marriage blog will help you find out more about the unexplored topics of marriage and help you overcome common challenges faced by couples. Key topics covered are anger issues, commitment, communication, decision making, forgiveness, joy & happiness, marital intimacy, and more! We help prepare and equip couples to build Christ-centered marriages.

feeds.title: Expedition Marriage
feeds.description: The Expedition Marriage blog is a Christian marriage coaching platform by Chris & Jamie Bailey, offering pastoral articles and podcast episodes that guide couples through relational growth, faith-centered communication, and practical strategies for a strong, Christ-focused marriage.

feeds.title: The Romantic Vineyard
feeds.description: A rich harvest of ideas to help your marriage grow.

feeds.title: Love Hope Adventure
feeds.description: The team at Love Hope Adventure wants to help couples build intimacy and love in their marriages. Check out our helpful blogs here.

feeds.title: Gary Thomas » Marriage
feeds.description: Here the Marriage content explores how to love difficult wives, abusive husbands, unhappy marriages, and more! Gray Thomas is a Christian bestselling author and speaker bringing people closer to Christ and closer to others.

feeds.title: Dr. Andrea Towers Scott Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! Here you'll find tips, tricks, and success strategies for all your relationships.

feeds.title: Agape Catholic Ministries Blog » Marriage
feeds.description: This blog focuses on conversion and sharing Catholic faith. Founded in 2007, the blog aims to help people grow in their faith and relationship with Jesus Christ. The blog provides resources, stories, and reflections related to conversion and living the Catholic faith.

feeds.title: Living the Sweet Wife - Hope for joyful marriages and healthy lifestyles! Blog
feeds.description: Blogging for Christian marriage advice, relationship tips, & healthy lifestyle inspiration.

feeds.title: Married and Young Blog
feeds.description: The mission of MarriedandYoung is to increase the marriage rate by helping men and women understand the biblical purpose of marriage, and the joy that comes from doing it God's way. We also exist to decrease the divorce rate by helping married couples stay married through biblical and practical wisdom.

feeds.title: Start Marriage Right - Enjoy the wedding. Love the marriage!
feeds.description: Whether you are single, dating, engaged, or newlyweds this blog offers you with articles, interviews, and resources to help you prepare for marriage. Our hope is that StartMarriageRight.com will be the one site that you'll want to come back to over and over again for biblical insight on relationships, faith, sex, money, family, and other issues that all couples face as you prepare for marriage.

feeds.title: The Generous Husband
feeds.description: This blog is about learning how to 'go the extra mile' for your wife, rather than doing only what you think is 'required'. Follow The Generous Husband blog for daily rants about being a better husband!

feeds.title: The Generous Wife
feeds.description: A daily reminder to grow your marriage authored by Lori. She started The Generous Wife as a way of encouraging women to build and grow their marriages. The Generous Wife tips are designed to be a daily reminder to bless your husband. They also create a pool of ideas that you can use when your imagination goes belly up and you can't think of anything to do.

feeds.title: Married By His Grace
feeds.description: Hello and Welcome! I am Carmen Brown. I am passionate about marriage & parenting all under the grace of God. This is a place focused on our calling to the ministry as a wife, mom, and lover of His word. In between it all, I teach new bloggers how to build with a purpose.

feeds.title: The Peaceful Wife
feeds.description: I am now a very happily married mother of two, part-time pharmacist, Christian marriage blogger, and author of 'The Peaceful Wife Living in Submission to Christ As Lord.' This blog is a place where I share the things that I WISH I knew when I was a newlywed in 1994.

feeds.title: Marriage Of God Blog
feeds.description: Hi! We are Brent and Angel Rhodes. We are Charleston, SC natives, currently residing in Katy, TX where we relocated nine years ago with Brent's job. Brent is employed with a major oil corporation. I am a former classroom teacher and currently serving active duty in the military.

feeds.title: Heaven Made Marriage Blog
feeds.description: I'm Scott Means, author and creator of resources that build intimate, passionate and enduring marriages according to God's design. My goal is to challenge, provoke, inform and, most of all, equip and motivate you to attain the depth of intimacy, passion and love you've always dreamed of in your marriage.

feeds.title: The Color of Marriage Blog
feeds.description: Hello, We are Joe & Rhonda Robinson, Marriage Replenishment Specialists. We specialize in helping couples like you fix and strengthen the broken and weak areas of your marriage. My wife Rhonda and I work side by side helping couples like you, move your marriage to greatness through the Christian faith.

feeds.title: My Marriage Is Worth It
feeds.description: God has blessed our marriage in so many ways. We went from having absolutely no hope to having a marriage that is full of abundant love and joy. We will be sharing how we did it and our prayers are that the lessons we learned will help those who of you who are in struggling marriages to have the marriage that you always dreamed of.

feeds.title: Godly Relationship and Marriage
feeds.description: We Martin and Chandy are certified Relationship and Marriage coaches. 'We believe Relationship is not about finding the right person; it is about becoming the right person.' Join us as we journey together to becoming the people God created us to be.

feeds.title: The Peaceful Wife Living in Submission to Christ as Lord
feeds.description: Hi, I am April Cassidy. I am now a very happily married mother of two, part-time pharmacist, Christian marriage blogger, and author of 'The Peaceful Wife Living in Submission to Christ As Lord. My mission is to bless women with the truth from the Bible in their journey and walk with God and in their marriages.

feeds.title: Scott LaPierre » Marriage
feeds.description: Scott LaPierre is the senior pastor of Woodland Christian Church, author of Marriage God's Way, Enduring Trials God's Way, and a conference speaker.

feeds.title: The Conscious Christian Marriage
feeds.description: Read inspiring stories of conscious Christian marriages. Learn to enhance your relationship through empathy & curiosity. Start your journey today!

feeds.title: Marriage After God
feeds.description: Unveiled Wife shares christian advice, christian marriage resources and Godly encouragement for wives. I write on faith, marriage and motherhood. My goal is to create an atmosphere where women feel safe to share their marriage experiences, find encouragement and affirm each other.

feeds.title: Time-Warp Wife
feeds.description: Daily Devotions & Bible Studies for Women. Author of more than 15 books, Darlene continues to write and minister to her readers through her blog.

feeds.title: HUSBAND REVOLUTION
feeds.description: Starting A Revolution Of Christ Like Leadership In Marriages. My name is Aaron Smith. I believe we as husbands have a unique and powerful opportunity to share Christ with the world simply in the way we love our wives.

feeds.title: To Love, Honor and Vacuum Blog
feeds.description: Sheila Wray Gregoire loves marriage! She writes books on marriage, blogs on marriage, and she speaks on marriage. She's is a Wife, speaker and the author of 8 books. Visit this page for marriage inspiration and more!

feeds.title: Intimacy in Marriage Blog
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Julie Sibert and I speak and write on sexual intimacy in marriage. I am simply a Christian wife with a heart to offer hope, encouragement, and resources on this sensitive topic.

feeds.title: Welcome To The Family Table
feeds.description: Marriage Legacy Builders Blog covers bible studies for couples, biblical parenting, Christian singles, faithfulness, goal setting for couples, marriage restoration, intimacy, marriage time management strategies, and scripture confessions. It is authored by Mike & Carlie Kercheval. We make marriage better and make people believe that it needs the right mind and heart.
